decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing the Bazaar of Baghdad to discard cards and quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Squee, Goblin Nabob. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and efficient use of resources, while also having some disruption and interaction tools to control the game tempo.

This deck focuses on playing small disruptive creatures that can quickly apply pressure to the opponent while hindering their ability to cast spells effectively. By combining aggressive creatures with hatebears that slow down the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of powerful mana acceleration cards allows the deck to deploy threats quickly and disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck seeks to create a fast-paced, disruptive game plan that can catch the opponent off guard and secure a quick victory.
